xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity output="false"}} ## The report form submits one request parameter per filter. Forward those by name rather than whatever the ## request happens to carry, so that the string built here is always a list of known macro parameters, and strip ## from each value the characters that would end the parameter it sits in. #set ($reportParameters = ['products', 'versions', 'audience', 'categories', 'importance', 'containsScreenshots', 'displayer']) #set ($parameters = "") #set ($filterQueryString = 'action=report') #foreach ($parameterName in $reportParameters) #set ($parameterValue = $stringtool.normalizeSpace("$!request.get($parameterName)")) #set ($parameterValue = $stringtool.remove($stringtool.remove($parameterValue, "'"), '"')) #if ($parameterValue != '') #set ($parameters = "$parameters $parameterName='$parameterValue' ") ## The same filters have to reach the other pages of this report, this time as request parameters. #set ($filterQueryString = "$filterQueryString&$parameterName=$escapetool.url($parameterValue)") #end #end ## The filters come from the request and default to wildcards, so the report can be asked for every change of a ## product at once. Display one page of changes at a time. The page size is fixed here rather than read from the ## request, otherwise a single URL would bring back the unbounded query this paging exists to avoid. #set ($reportPageSize = 20) #set ($reportOffset = $numbertool.toNumber("$!request.offset")) #if (!$reportOffset || $reportOffset.intValue() < 0) #set ($reportOffset = 0) #else #set ($reportOffset = $reportOffset.intValue()) #end #set ($previousOffset = $mathtool.max(0, $mathtool.sub($reportOffset, $reportPageSize))) #set ($nextOffset = $mathtool.add($reportOffset, $reportPageSize)) #macro (displayReportPageLink $newOffset $labelKey) #set ($label = $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render($labelKey))) #set ($pageURL = $escapetool.xml($doc.getURL('view', "${filterQueryString}&offset=${newOffset}"))) $label #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} {{getChanges $parameters limit="$reportPageSize" offset="$reportOffset" contextVariable='reportChanges'/}} {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} {{displayChanges $parameters contextVariable='reportChanges'/}} {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} ## getChanges publishes whether it had more changes to return, which is what tells a next page apart from the last ## one without counting the whole result set. #if ($reportOffset > 0 || $reportChangesHasMore) {{html clean="false"}}
#if ($reportOffset > 0) #displayReportPageLink($previousOffset 'releasenotes.report.previous') #end #if ($reportChangesHasMore) #displayReportPageLink($nextOffset 'releasenotes.report.next') #end
{{/html}} #end {{/velocity}}
